---
title: Duplicate cell ids
format:
  typst:
    keep-typ: true
    code-annotations: true
_quarto:
  tests:
    typst:
      noErrors: default
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: "Duplicate code cell id 'lst-a'"
      ensureTypstFileRegexMatches:
        -
          - 'cell-id: "lst-a", annotations'
          - 'cell-id: "lst-a-2", annotations'
          - 'quarto-annotation-item\("lst-a-2"'
        -
          - 'quarto-code-annotations:'
---

```{#lst-a .python}
x = 1  # <1>
```

1. First.

```{#lst-a .python}
y = 2  # <1>
```

1. Second.
